name: hueyhover
steps: log hot start on the ALBATROSS: flight idle, the throttle rolls on to 6600 rpm by itself
log lift off with the keys (Space raises the collective), then hold a 25 ft hover hands-off with the stability assist (collective by a height-hold loop)

eval (window.__c = __G.H.c.coll, window.__ap = setInterval(()=>{ const H=__G.H; const tgt = (8 - H.agl) * 0.5; window.__c = Math.min(0.6, Math.max(0, window.__c + (Math.max(-2, Math.min(2, tgt)) - H.vel.y) * 0.002 - (H.rpm < 0.95 ? 0.004 : 0))); __G.HI.setCollective(window.__c); }, 16), 1)

eval (()=>{ const H=__G.H, a=H.attitude(); return {agl:+H.agl.toFixed(1), drift:+Math.hypot(H.vel.x-(__G.war.carrier.v.x), H.vel.z-(__G.war.carrier.v.z)).toFixed(2), gs:+Math.hypot(H.vel.x,H.vel.z).toFixed(2), pitch:+(a.pitch*57.3).toFixed(1), roll:+(-a.roll*57.3).toFixed(1), psi:+H.torque.toFixed(1), coll:+H.c.coll.toFixed(2), pedal:+H.c.ped.toFixed(2), lat:+H.c.lat.toFixed(2), lon:+H.c.lon.toFixed(2), nr:+H.rpm.toFixed(3), ge:+H.ge.toFixed(2), line:document.getElementById('alt').textContent}; })()
log forward flight: W for 3 s (attitude command: nose down), then hands off at speed
eval (()=>{ const H=__G.H; return {ias:+H.ias.toFixed(0), agl:+H.agl.toFixed(0), psi:+H.torque.toFixed(1), etl:+H.etl.toFixed(2), pitch:+(H.attitude().pitch*57.3).toFixed(1)}; })()
log right pedal turn (E) with the yaw-rate command, then level
